organizationPage.title: My organization

invitations.title: Invite someone
invitations.help: They get a link and join only if they accept it with their own account. The link expires in 7 days and is shown only once.
invitations.linkReady: Invitation created. Copy the link and send it to them: it won’t be shown again.

errors.invalid: Check the email, role and scope.
errors.forbidden: You don’t have permission to invite people to this organization.

accept.title: Invitation
accept.body: You’ve been invited to an organization on {brand}. You’ll join with your account {email}.
accept.invalid: This invitation isn’t valid: it may have expired, been revoked or be meant for another account.
accept.already: You already belong to this organization.

security.title: Security
security.on: On: when you sign in we will ask for a code from your authenticator app.
security.requiredForAdmins: You manage an organization: you need it to make changes (invite people, change locations, roles or organization details).
security.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…).
security.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
security.manual: Can't scan it? Type this key into the app:

errors.enroll: We couldn't start the setup. Please try again.
errors.code: That code isn't right. Try the one your app shows now.
